title: Graduation Ceremony 2022｜Social Intelligence Laboratory, Ritsumeikan University

summary.lead: The 4th year undergraduate students (4th class) and 2nd year master's students (2nd class) graduated.

overview: Graduation and degree conferment ceremonies were held for the fourth-year undergraduate students and second-year master's students in the class of 2023! Congratulations to all graduates! Finally, it is time for you to enter the workforce. I sincerely wish you all the best in your respective fields. I sincerely wish you all the best in your future endeavors.
